themes.description: This theme covers issues related to opening, closing, or managing user accounts, including options for reopening accounts or updating account details.
Overall user satisfaction, general feedback on app quality, and non-functional aspects like advertisements or UI/UX.
Reviews expressing general satisfaction, positive comparisons to competitors, or overall sentiment about the app's quality and usability.
Reviews related to in-app advertisements, promotional content, or marketing practices that impact user experience.
This theme covers problems related to specific financial products or facilities offered, including difficulties in managing, exiting, or understanding their implications.
Issues related to specific features not working, being unavailable, or not performing as expected within the application.
Problems related to account activation, verification, profile management, or specific trading segment access.
Problems related to account creation, KYC verification, document processing, and personal detail management.
Issues or limitations related to available trading instruments, order types, or specific trading functionalities.
Feedback on available trading instruments, order types, feature limitations, or general trading functionality.
This theme covers issues related to trade execution, order placement difficulties, and the overall user experience during trading activities.
This theme covers issues related to the display, analysis, and reporting of financial data, including P&L statements and performance metrics.
Concerns or complaints related to specific trading products, features, or their perceived fairness/effectiveness.
Reviews expressing overall satisfaction or positive sentiment without detailing specific features or services.
Feedback or complaints regarding the application's design, layout, navigation, or overall user experience.
Issues related to specific trading features, order execution, stop-loss, or other core trading operations.
Feedback on the application's user interface, design, layout, and display of information.
